summary: National Healthcare Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a registered underwritten public offering of 38,500,000 shares of Class A common stock at an undisclosed price; underwriters also exercised an option for an additional 5,775,000 shares to cover overallotments, expected to close April 28, 2026. The underwriting agreement includes customary representations, conditions, and indemnification. This is a routine equity offering, not a special situation; there is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring involved. Watch for the final pricing details in subsequent filings, but there is no risk-arb angle as this is a straightforward capital raise.
